text:
maria: @channel kicking off a stepwise warmup for release v2.8.3 — rolling traffic in eu-west in stages: 5% -> 15% -> 30%. change window 18:00-19:00 UTC. deploy-bot: starting rollout job deploy_1742103333
deploy-bot: [info] staged rollout initiated target=eu-west sequence=[5,15,30] hold_each=5m rollback_on=[5xx>1%, p99>250ms]
jamal: quick question — what's our current baseline for p99?
ops-lee: baseline p99=180ms, errors ~0.2% (30m)
sre-lex: heads up — kv-cache hit rate has dipped on a couple canary shards, i'll keep eyes
maria: thresholds: hold if p99 > 220ms OR errors > 1% at any step. we'll meet if it hits.
jamal: can we temporarily increase request sampling to get traces for the first step?
sre-lex: added trace flag and 1% sampling, will paste links after step completes
deploy-bot: step 1 complete -> 5% live (instances: 8/160). metrics: p99=185ms, errors=0.25% :thumbsup:
ops-lee: looks nominal from infra side
maria: plan to proceed to 15% in 2m. quick vote — react with :thumbsup: to proceed, :no_entry: to hold
jamal: :thumbsup:
ops-lee: :thumbsup:
sre-lex: :no_entry: seeing a 3% spike in backend queue latency, recommend hold for 5m to investigate
maria: holding. tagging infra + backend for triage — @backend-lead @ops-lee
deploy-bot: automatic rollback not triggered; rollout paused at the 15% step (manual hold)
backend-lead: we pushed a small DB index tweak earlier, looks correlated to queue spike. reverting index now, ETA 3m
maria: thanks. once revert finishes we retest step and decide proceed vs rollback
sre-lex: post-revert metrics: p99 down to 190ms, errors 0.3%
ops-lee: good to continue to 15% from infra POV
jamal: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: advancing -> 15% (instances: 24/160). metrics: p99=192ms, errors=0.35%
maria: proceeding to 30% in 10m unless new signals. publishing a short release note update: https://go/release/notes/v2.8.3
release-bot: Release notes published: v2.8.3 — minor perf tweaks + model ref update
maria: final quickvote — go to 30%? reply with :thumbsup: to advance or :no_entry: to hold
ops-lee: :thumbsup:
jamal: :thumbsup:
sre-lex: monitoring, no objections at the moment
maria: rolling to 30% now. reminder: rollback triggers: p99>250ms OR 5xx>1% -> immediate rollback + incident page
deploy-bot: 30% achieved. metrics stable: p99=195ms, errors=0.4% :tada:
maria: thanks team. if nothing regresses i'll schedule a short recap 09:00 UTC tomorrow and close the change window.
